Among 1465675 records, 280679 can be identified to be within the US, and 261112 can be identified to US states.

Filter and clean data

Filtering criteria: - no duplicated unique id - posted in English - have the exact keyword “pollen” in the cleaned text (not a part of a longer word, not in tags, not in urls) - identified to be within the US Cleaning steps (original text still kept): - remove line breaks - remove url - remove tag - remove “RT” at the start - remove non-words - convert character encoding from UTF-8 to ASCII

There were 190473 tweets that satisfied all criteria and were used in the following analyses.
